newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FLORIDIENNE IN DETERGENTS VENTURE WITH WALLONIA.
newsitem.headline: FLORIDIENNE IN DETERGENTS VENTURE WITH WALLONIA.

text.p: The Walloon government decided on Thursday to take a stake of up to 49 percent in a new joint venture being formed with Belgian specialty chemicals and snail importing firm S.A. Floridienne .
The new firm, S.A. Financiere D'Ath>, will have a capital of 45 million francs, of which the Walloon government will provide up to 22 million with the rest coming from Floridienne.
Floridienne wants to use Financiere D'Ath to develop a detergent arm, the Walloon government said in a statement.
